theorem.name: L4_IDENTITY_STATE_ESCAPE
theorem.statement: For every encoded 3CNF input F of size N, there exists an exact live representation of the current SAT instance using O(N) space: retain F itself (plus O(number_of_variables) bits for a current assignment/work indices). Therefore no theorem of the form EVERY exact SAT state representation requires superpolynomial space can be true without additional restrictions on the representation or allowed operations.
proof: The input encoding F is itself an exact representation of the Boolean constraint set and has size N by definition.
A deterministic exhaustive SAT decider can retain F and enumerate one assignment at a time, using O(N) live storage up to ordinary indexing/workspace overhead.
The decider is exact and total, but may take exponential time.
Hence polynomial live-state size alone does not imply polynomial-time solvability, and a universal superpolynomial L4-only lower bound is refuted by this identity-state construction.

consequences: R44AC remains valid as an architecture-specific barrier for full-function structured DNNF bottom-up compilation.
L4 by itself is not the central P-vs-NP obstruction: exact exponential-time algorithms can satisfy a polynomial state envelope.
Any future L4 lower bound must fix extra semantics/operations, such as full-function compilation, context-complete quotient constraints, decomposability, or a specified update algebra.
Compression is not required merely to satisfy L4; it is required only if a chosen architecture creates superpolynomial intermediate state.

macrostep_accounting_cleanup.example: One may define a single macrostep that performs exhaustive search. L5 can then look trivial while L3 correctly charges exponential work inside that macrostep.
macrostep_accounting_cleanup.consequence: L3 and L5 cannot be interpreted as independent percentages of a polynomial-time proof; charged work and step count must be composed.

legend_dependency_map.L5_small_macrostep_count_alone: can be vacuous if work is hidden inside a macrostep; L3 forbids this
legend_dependency_map.L6_polynomial_replay_on_UNSAT: nontrivial and already linked to NP=coNP-level certificate existence in R44Y
legend_dependency_map.core_uniform_algorithmic_bottleneck: L3 charged polynomial discovery/local work combined with exact universal totality and a polynomial number of charged steps

next_admissible_front.reason: R44AB already shows generic p-bounded Cook-Reckhow proof search reaches P=NP-level difficulty; R44AD shows L4 alone cannot supply the missing obstruction because polynomial-space exact representations are trivial.
